confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates use recent city cost-of-living data, which is user-contributed and varies by venue. The wine-by-the-glass anchor is estimated from local drink pricing. Accommodation values are broad model estimates based on general knowledge; no live booking listings were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Melbourne-specific cost-of-living observations. Accommodation is estimated from general knowledge of large Australian cities.
